answer_1.quote: Since the inception of Large Language Models (LLMs), the paradigm of machine translation (MT) has been shifting toward an LLM-based approach.

answer_2.quote: Our experiments cover both reference-based and reference-free ("QE") variants of COMET and MetricX. We calculate the segment-level translation quality using existing metrics, then average the scores to obtain a document-level score.

answer_4.quote: We use the dataset from the WMT 2024 Metrics Shared Task (Freitag et al., 2024), which contains ... MQM human evaluations of the system translations. Meta-Evaluation ... we use correlation between document-level scores and human judgments as the primary metric.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators provided MQM scores for each segment, which were averaged to obtain document-level scores.
